ALTER PROC [d360].[SP_hash_log_TRU] AS
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS Sequence
,       [name]
,       'WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT COUNT(*) COUNT_TGT, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H = ''D''
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,''F-'','''') COUNT_SRC, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.'+name+' WHERE H <> ''D''
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,''_SRC'','''') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) src

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT )
) pvt2' 
 AS sql_code

FROM    sys.tables  WHERE NAME LIKE 'STG_%' and schema_id = 9 and name not like '%logging' and name in (
'STG_TRU_ACCOUNT'
--,'STG_TRU_AUMUITF'
,'STG_TRU_BASELINK'
,'STG_TRU_BASEMST'
,'STG_TRU_CUST'
,'STG_TRU_FXRATES'
--,'STG_TRU_NONUITFTRANMST'
--,'STG_TRU_NONUITFTRANREVMST'
,'STG_TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION'
,'STG_TRU_TRUPRODUCTS'
,'STG_TRU_TRURM'
--,'STG_TRU_UITFTRANMST'

)
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE Sequence = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;

-------------------------TRU_AUMUITF----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT CONVERT(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP)),0) CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP)),0) TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_TRU_AUMUITF WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT CONVERT(numeric(25,5),REPLACE(H,'F-','')) COUNT_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP) CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP) TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_TRU_AUMUITF WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt
,TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,CAST(TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,CAST(CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt
,CAST(TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src
,TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,CUSTOMER_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt
,TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');



-------------------------TRU_AUMNONUITF----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),AUM)),0) AUM_tgt
,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),AUM_IN_PHP)),0) AUM_IN_PHP_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),AUM) AUM_src
,convert(numeric(25,5),AUM_IN_PHP) AUM_IN_PHP_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_TRU_AUMNONUITF WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
,AUM_src
,AUM_IN_PHP_src
,AUM_tgt
,AUM_IN_PHP_tgt

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as COUNT_SRC 
,CAST(COUNT_TGT  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as COUNT_TGT 
,CAST(AUM_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as AUM_src 
,CAST(AUM_IN_PHP_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as AUM_IN_PHP_src 
,CAST(AUM_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as AUM_tgt 
,CAST(AUM_IN_PHP_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as AUM_IN_PHP_tgt 
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
,AUM_src
,AUM_IN_PHP_src

 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,AUM_tgt
,AUM_IN_PHP_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');





-------------------------TRU_PORTFOLIO----------------------------------

,isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),GARNISHMENT_AMT)),0) GARNISHMENT_AMT_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_TRU_PORTFOLIO WHERE H <> 'D'
)

SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC

FROM
(
SELECT 
 CAST(COUNT_SRC  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as COUNT_SRC

,CAST(GARNISHMENT_AMT_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) as GARNISHMENT_AMT_src

(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
,GARNISHMENT_AMT_tgt

 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');



END
GO
